subject: POC onramp: network handoff, API keys & peering window
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Malik <sanjay.malik@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC onramp: network handoff, API keys & peering window

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time earlier. I put together a short onramp checklist and a proposed week-of schedule to get the POC environment ready. Attached: a draft MAP that captures the commitments and a simple network diagram showing the VPC peering flow.

High-level requested items from Acme for the environment prep:
- Cloud org/account ID for peering (we need the numeric project/account id)
- CIDR(s) you plan to use and any NAT egress ranges to allowlist
- Network contact for a quick peering handshake (name + email + preferred time window)
- Confirmation if you want ephemeral API keys or long-lived keys for the POC (we recommend ephemeral with 7d rotation)

Our proposed schedule (all times PDT):
- Wed 05/05: Redwood provisions org and creates service account + API key (staging)
- Thu 05/06: Network teams do VPC peering & route propagation (3-4h window)
- Fri 05/07: Smoke tests + run eval prompt set, share initial perf/cost numbers

Action items for you: share the account id and network contact by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the peering window.

Attachments: RDW_MAP_ACME_DRAFT.pdf, network-diagram-acme-redwood.png, vpc-peering-template.txt

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Sanjay Malik <sanjay.malik@acmehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onramp: network handoff, API keys & peering window

Thanks Lukas — this looks good and aligns with our timelines.

Quick answers from network:
- Account ID (AWS): 111222333444
- VPC CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16
- Egress NAT ranges (approx): 52.34.12.0/24 (we'll confirm exact list)
- Network contact: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@acmehealth.com> (cc'd) — Claire can do a 2-hour window on Thu 05/06 between 09:00–12:00 PDT.

A couple of questions:
1) Are the Redwood API keys scoped to the POC org only? We prefer ephemeral keys for security; how do you manage rotation?
2) We have to provide a short security blurb to our audit team (SOC2 + retention). Can you attach a one-page note for the MAP that covers data retention and logging?

I attached the CSV with our VPC metadata.

— Sanjay

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: POC onramp: network handoff, API keys & peering window

Looping you both in with Sanjay's answers — account id and CIDR are below. Claire is available Thu 09:00–12:00 PDT for peering.

Hannah: can you provision the POC org + create an ephemeral service key scoped to the staging project? Prefer TTL 7d and log creation in the MAP. Use the "ephemeral-poc" role.
Vivek: please prepare the peering template with Acme's CIDR and our peering subnet, and run through the firewall allowlist for 52.34.12.0/24 (we'll confirm exact egress after Claire sends final). Also add a 1-page security blurb on retention and logging for the MAP (San needs it for audit).

I'll send the formal peering invite and the DocuSign for the MAP once you confirm readiness.

— Lukas
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Malik <sanjay.malik@acmehealth.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onramp: network handoff, API keys & peering window

Hi Sanjay — looping back with a quick confirmation.

1) Org & API keys: I created the POC staging org in our console and generated an ephemeral service key with 7d TTL. We will scope it to Acme's account (111222333444) and the "ephemeral-poc" role as requested. For handoff, we'll share the key via our secrets exchange (one-time secure link).
2) Peering window: Thu 05/06, 09:30–11:30 PDT is our target (fits Claire's window). Vivek will be on the call to validate routes.
3) Security blurb: attached a short one-pager summarizing retention (30 days for request logs, token metadata only; no customer data retained beyond elected evaluation storage; audit logs retained per SOC2 config).

Attachments: org-setup-steps.md
Related: DocuSign MAP link (will be sent once Claire confirms peering IPs).

If that works, I'll kick off the peering coordinate and send a calendar invite.

— Hannah
